column1: # The letters and figures, as marks (the user, 25 November 2026): each
# the pin's frame, a rounded square from 2.5 to 21.5 round by 5.5, so
# every mark has one squarish form; inside it the letter drawn with the
# icons' one stroke, every corner round by 3, its inner spaces large
# and square (a p's bowl a rounded square, not a pill). The letter's box:
# sides 6.5 and 17.5; ascender 6.75, x-height 9, line 15.5, descender
# 17.75. A mark stands for a name with no picture of its own, as large as
# the icons beside it. Read with icon.tsv as one table.
